desc: Derive a correct compact recurrence for the game using only the parity of \(A_i\) and the counts of odd/even indices.
Determine and implement the winner criterion, including exact handling for \(N=1,\dots,7\) and the Lucas-theorem criterion for \(N\ge8\).
Verify that values with the same parity are strategically equivalent.
Validate the solution against all public samples.
Implement fast input parsing and exact `Fennec`/`Snuke` output.
